scenarios.name: mk-enter
scenarios.description: Enter and leave masking every way; Delete with no mask; overlay outside masking.

steps.note: M from grid shows the loupe
Delete with no mask must not reject the photo

scenarios.name: mk-linear
scenarios.description: Linear gradient: draw, move, falloff, swing, rotate, new with cmd; adjust Exposure; overlay rule; O; undo/redo chain; leave.

steps.note: overlay hides the moment you adjust

scenarios.name: mk-radial
scenarios.description: Radial: draw, move by off-centre press, rim resize, outside rotate; adjust; expand row; Feather; Rotation; invert key.

scenarios.name: mk-brush
scenarios.description: Brush: three strokes, undo one, redo, option-erase, keys [ ] shift-] digits A, adjust Exposure, panel brush controls.

scenarios.name: mk-colourpick
scenarios.description: Colour Pick: armed eyedropper, sample a cell, adjust, exposure independence, Colour Range with Tolerance.

scenarios.name: mk-range
scenarios.description: Brightness Range From/To and Luminosity Level on the fiducial.

scenarios.name: mk-ai-5d
scenarios.description: AI Subject, then People and Background, on a real raw.

scenarios.name: mk-ai-a7
scenarios.description: AI Subject, then People and Background, on a real raw.

scenarios.name: mk-multiselect
scenarios.description: Two-plus photos selected: masks and strokes go only to the active photo.

scenarios.name: mk-switch
scenarios.description: Switch photo while masking, paint on the next one, come back; leave masking straight after a stroke.

scenarios.name: mk-local
scenarios.description: A linear mask over the lower half; each local slider moved then reset; Strength scaling via typed values.

scenarios.name: mk-overlay
scenarios.description: Overlay modes and tints (alt-O, shift-O), the panel Overlay control cycle, hide-then-hover.

scenarios.name: mk-algebra
scenarios.description: Radial, then Subtract a linear and Intersect; component op segmented; Another Mask.
